title: Jeff Lewis Returns to Bravo With ‘Still Flipping Out’ — Get More Jeff on SiriusXM
summary: Catch Jeff’s recaps of “Still Flipping Out” on “Jeff Lewis Live,” a special “Front Row” with the cast, and more.
body_markdown:
[Jeff Lewis](https://www.siriusxm.com/hosts/jeff-lewis) is back on Bravo with his new eight-part series[Still Flipping Out](https://www.bravotv.com/still-flipping-out) — and SiriusXM listeners can go even deeper with Jeff throughout the week.


Premiering Monday, September 28, *Still Flipping Out* follows the renowned interior designer and house flipper in his latest television series. Much of the show was filmed at SiriusXM’s studios, where Jeff records[Jeff Lewis Live](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/jeff-lewis-live) .


[Jeff Lewis Live Hear the latest episodes Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogTagPage-JeffLL)


And the conversation doesn’t stop there. New episodes of *Still Flipping Out* premiere Monday nights on Bravo. For more Jeff and all of his unfiltered takes, tune in to *Jeff Lewis Live* every weekday. Plus, join the conversation and tell Jeff what’s on your mind via his *Bitch Box* below.


### **Listen to *Jeff Lewis Live* on SiriusXM**


Hear *Jeff Lewis Live* weekdays on[Radio Andy (Ch. 101)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/radio-andy) on satellite radios and the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogTagPage-JeffLL) .


It’s Jeff Lewis just the way fans want him: live and uncensored. Jeff and his band of “Chumps” take on everything from the news of the day to the world of reality TV and everything in between.


With Jeff recapping each new *Still Flipping Out* episode on Tuesdays, fans can watch the Bravo series Monday night and then hear even more from Jeff the next day on SiriusXM.


### **Bitch Box: Submit a Message to *Jeff Lewis Live***


Want to be heard on *Jeff Lewis* *Live* ? Submit a voice, video, or text message to the show via the *Bitch Box* :


[What would you like to ask Jeff and the Chumps? Submit a Message Submit a Message](https://hotline.web-cloud.siriusxm.com/jeff-lewis)


### **Hear the *Still Flipping Out* *Front Row* Special**


SiriusXM is also celebrating the new Bravo series with a special *Still Flipping Out* *Front Row* event taped Monday, September 28 at the SiriusXM Studios in New York.


Hosted by[Page Six Radio’s Danny Murphy and Evan Real](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/page-six-radio) , the special features Jeff Lewis alongside Shane Douglas, Doug Budin, and Cian O’Maitiu.


The *Still Flipping Out* Front Row airs Tuesday, September 29 at 9am ET on[Stars (Ch. 138)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/stars-on-siriusxm) and will also be available on demand on the SiriusXM app.
